API docs by Redocly

OBX Node Admin + Portal API (0.2.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

License: CC-BY-4.0

The API between the shared admin-ui and a node (brand admin + retailer portal).

Non-normative. Not part of the OBX standard; it is the contract between the shared admin-ui (a static single-page app) and the reference nodes (node-go, node-php, node-ts), so one UI works on every node. Other OBX implementations are free to build their own UI.

Serving. A node serves the admin-ui build at / with single-page-app fallback: any GET that is not under /admin/api, /obx/ or /.well-known/ and accepts text/html returns index.html. UI routes that the node itself links to (e-mails): /invite/{token}, /reset-password/{token}, /request-access, /login. The node's public base URL comes from its configuration (OBX_PUBLIC_URL).

Sessions. Cookie obx_session (HttpOnly, Secure except on http://localhost, SameSite=Lax, Path=/), sliding expiry, at most 30 days, invalidated on logout, password change and blocking. Bearer tokens are NOT accepted here.

CSRF. Every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE under /admin/api MUST carry header X-CSRF-Token equal to the csrf_token returned by GET /admin/api/session (which works without being logged in and sets the matching HttpOnly cookie obx_csrf), else 403 csrf_failed. Login rotates the token (use the one in the login response).

Roles. admin (the brand) and retailer. /admin/api/portal/* is for retailers; admins may call it too and get a preview of everything published (their downloads are not logged). Everything else except public/session/setup/password/invite endpoints requires admin. Before first-run setup every other endpoint answers 409 setup_required.

Catalog writes. /admin/api/catalog/* has exactly the semantics of the OBX Ingest API (same bodies, results, errors, change-feed effects), just with session auth.

Errors. application/problem+json with obx_error (docs/protocol.md#errors). Lists use limit + opaque cursor and return {items, next_cursor}.

Complete the first-run wizard

Creates the brand profile, the first brand and the first admin (password chosen here; there is never a default password) and logs in. Requires the one-time setup_code that the node prints in its log on first start (or that the operator preset with OBX_SETUP_CODE), so nobody else can claim a freshly deployed node. Rate limited (10 per 15 min per IP). 409 setup_completed once done.

header Parameters
X-CSRF-Token
required
string
Request Body schema: application/json
required
setup_code
required
string [ 6 .. 64 ] characters
required
object

path Parameters
external_id
required

header Parameters
X-CSRF-Token
required
string
Request Body schema: application/json
required
product_external_id
required
string (ExternalId) [ 1 .. 200 ] characters ^[^\x00-\x1F\x7F/]+$

The brand's own identifier for an object (from its PIM/ERP/spreadsheet). 1-200 characters, no control characters and no '/'. Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed by nodes. Compared case-sensitively.

color_code
string or null <= 64 characters
variant_external_ids
Array of strings or null (ExternalId) [ items [ 1 .. 200 ] characters ^[^\x00-\x1F\x7F/]+$ ]
media_type
string
Value: "image"
role
required
string (Role)
Enum: "packshot" "model" "detail" "ghost" "flatlay" "scene" "swatch" "size_chart" "other"

What the image shows. Stable key; labels are presentation.

View (string) or null
position
required
integer [ 1 .. 999 ]
filename
string or null <= 255 characters

Download filename; default <external_id>.<ext>.

LocalizedText (object) or null
object or null

Partial Rights; omitted fields take the node's default rights (Settings). null = all defaults.

object or null

Omitted fields default to ai_generated=false, ai_edited=false, source=photo (generated when ai_generated), c2pa=none (nodes MAY detect embedded C2PA).

object or null

Attach previously uploaded blobs atomically. Omit to keep current files (or upload via PUT .../files/{rendition}).

status
string (PublicationStatus)
Enum: "published" "unpublished"

Brand-side publication state. Only 'published' objects (with published parents) are visible through the OBX Protocol.

^x-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9_-]+$
pattern property
any

Approve

Creates (or links) the retailer, optionally invites the contact as a portal user (e-mail with a one-time link) and optionally creates an API client whose secret is handed to the requester exactly once via the protocol status endpoint. 409 conflict if not pending.

Authorizations:
session
path Parameters
id
required
string (Id) ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$

required
string
Request Body schema: application/json
optional

string (Id) ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$

brand_ids

invite_portal_user
